name: Staff of Power
description: A staff of black wood shod in iron and crowned with a dark crystal.
attuned_by: by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
body:
## What it does

It fights as a magic quarterstaff that strikes truer and harder than a plain one, and while you hold it you are harder to hit, steadier against harm and your spell attacks strike truer. A hit can spend a charge for a burst of force.

## Charges

It holds twenty and regains 2d8 + 4 each dawn. Spend the last and it may lose all but its weapon magic, or roar back with fresh charges.

## Retributive strike

You can break it to unleash everything it holds in a 30-foot sphere, with an even chance of being flung to another plane before it reaches you.

features.name: Retributive Strike
features.text: Break it as an action and it explodes in a 30-foot sphere. Half the time you escape to another plane; otherwise you take 16 force damage per charge left. Everyone else in it makes a DC 17 Dexterity save, taking 8, 6 or 4 per charge as they stand within 10, 20 or 30 feet, half on a success.

charges.last: roll a d20; on a 1 it keeps only its +2 as a weapon, on a 20 it regains 1d8 + 2 charges
